Nuanced discussion is unlikely to change entrenched patterns of belief. Every person on the planet believes his or her actions are right in the moment he acts. After he acts, he will look for reasons to justify his actions. The way to confront behavior you find objectionable is never impose more moderation- that method has been attempted countless times in countless ways and always fails. The best way is to improve yourself and figure out why another person's words hurt you so and if the pain you experience is real or a delusion. Then help and support the person you find objectionable, while following a better path yourself. In the end, it's just words. Long suffering, kindness, compassion, and good humor are the ways to encourage others to change- never an authoritarian hand or silencing him or her.
